title: Nationwide shipping -> checkout -> payment gateway E2E

verified.shipping_method: ارسال با باربری یا تیپاکس به سراسر کشور (هزینه حمل پس‌کرایه)

interpretation: A non-local Tehran checkout successfully passed the nationwide shipping rules and WooCommerce checkout validation.
The enabled WC_bitpayir2 gateway successfully produced an external Shaparak/Mellat payment redirect.
The browser intentionally aborted before loading the external bank payment page; no card data or payment was submitted.
This proves checkout-to-gateway reachability, not successful payment settlement/callback.
remaining_payment_gate: Successful card payment, callback, order status transition, and settlement were not tested because that would require a real/sandbox payment.
